title: Scope Creep in Autonomous Code Modification: When Do Code Agents Exceed Their Assigned Scope?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Scope creep in code agents has direct, irreversible consequences. Identifying predictors of scope creep and testing system prompt constraints provides actionable defense knowledge. Clear causal chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CS students can create a test codebase with known bugs, run a code-writing agent, and diff the changes. Measuring out-of-scope modifications is a straightforward diff analysis. Testing system prompt constraints is simple prompt engineering. Highly accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 30 bug fixes with scope analysis is a moderate amount of work. The test codebase setup takes time. Could be scoped to 15 bugs and still produce meaningful results. The system prompt constraint test adds a nice but bounded second experiment.
